findings.title: totalPages off-by-one for exact multiples
findings.body: totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, so 100 members with limit 50 yields 3 pages instead of 2. The controller's next action clamps offset to user_count, so the UI can navigate to a third empty page and shows currentPage/totalPages incorrectly.

findings.title: members limit is unbounded
findings.body: limit is taken as (params[:limit] || 50).to_i with no maximum or negative check. A caller can request limit=1000000 or larger, forcing order/limit/offset over the whole group membership and serializing it in one response, which is a CPU/memory DoS vector. Clamp limit to a sane maximum.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace around usernames
findings.body: usernames.split(",") passes each token directly to User.find_by_username. Comma+space separated input like "bob, alice" leaves a leading space on the second token so the lookup fails and the user is silently skipped. Strip each token and skip blanks.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise
findings.body: When the group name is empty findMembers does bare return, previously it returned Ember.RSVP.resolve([]). Callers such as the next/previous actions return group.findMembers() and route setup expects a thenable, so they now get undefined and any .then chaining throws.

findings.title: remove_member spec uses wrong HTTP verb
findings.body: The spec calls xhr :put, :remove_member but config/routes.rb defines delete members => groups#remove_member. Controller specs bypass routing, so the test passes without ever exercising the real DELETE route and would not catch a verb/routing mismatch.

findings.title: stray closing div inside table
findings.body: The members table contains a stray before {{/each}} with no matching opening div, producing invalid HTML inside the table. Browsers will repair it unpredictably, which can break row layout.
